task: A support agent asks: 'Our customer on the Growth plan wants to downgrade to Starter mid-cycle. What happens to their billing and their seats?' Answer using only the policy brief below. Reply as exactly three bullet points, each one sentence. No preamble, no closing line.
brief: Downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing period; the customer keeps Growth features until then.
No prorated refund is issued for a mid-cycle downgrade. The unused portion is not credited.
Starter is capped at 5 seats. If the account has more than 5 active seats at the period end, the downgrade is blocked and support must remove seats first.
The customer receives an automated email 3 days before the change takes effect.

rubric.instruction_following: Three bullet points, one sentence each, no preamble or closing line.
rubric.factual_correctness: Every statement matches the policy brief.
rubric.completeness: Covers both halves of the question: billing and seats.
rubric.directness: Answers the question asked without padding or hedging.

outputs.label: excellent
outputs.text:
- The downgrade takes effect at the end of the current billing period, and the customer keeps Growth features until then.
- No prorated refund is issued for the unused portion of the cycle.
- Starter is capped at 5 seats, so if the account still has more than 5 active seats at the period end the downgrade is blocked until support removes seats.

outputs.label: answers a different question
outputs.text:

- The customer is charged the difference on the next invoice.
- Seat limits are lifted as soon as the upgrade is processed.

outputs.label: correct but ignores the format constraint
outputs.text:
Great question! Here is what happens when a Growth customer downgrades mid-cycle.

Billing: the downgrade takes effect at the end of the current billing period, so they keep Growth features until then, and there is no prorated refund for the unused portion. This trips people up fairly often, so it is worth saying explicitly to the customer up front.

Seats: Starter allows a maximum of 5 seats. If the account still has more than 5 active seats when the period ends, the downgrade is blocked, and support needs to remove seats before it can go through.

Hope that helps! Let me know if you want me to draft the customer email.
